policy.description_en: Independent GPT and Claude assessments of reader appeal. Each model has equal weight.
policy.description_sl: Neodvisni oceni bralske privlačnosti GPT in Claude. Vsak model ima enako utež.

comments.claude: Original, idea-rich premise (an empty chair meaning different things to two peoples) with a real deadline and humane, villain-free stakes; the consent protocol is clever and quotable. But clinical, procedural prose, interchangeable aphoristic voices, a thinly drawn Illuminara and heavy litre arithmetic make it more admired than loved.
comments.gpt: Izviren nesporazum, nujen rok in spoštljiv spor bodo te bralce verjetno obdržali do konca. Postopek dogovarjanja je zadovoljiv, vendar številčni izračuni in ponovljeni krogi nekoliko upočasnijo zgodbo.

suggestions.claude: Illuminara's decisive contributions, the 'lose without losing itself' question and the first-rain/resin-gate discovery, appear only as indirect narration, so the consent machinery gets full scenes while the substantive solution gets summary. Dramatizing her proposal and the pushback it meets would make her decisive role visibly earned.
suggestions.gpt: Illuminarina skrb se kaže predvsem v zasnovi rešitve; prizor njenega neposrednega, osebno zahtevnega dejanja za ogrožene družine bi okrepil ljubezen kot dejavno silo.

NARA-D-2026-10-09:S2.title: THE BORDER DRAWN THROUGH A CHILD

comments.claude: A striking premise (a dying child split between two lawful birth records), a ticking clock, good-faith adversaries and quotable payoffs suit these readers. But the middle turns into legal-procedural summary of clause drafting and forensic chains, with terse position-taking dialogue and an unexplained Illuminara. Many will skim; the tender ending largely redeems it.
comments.gpt: Tavijina stiska daje pravnemu problemu človeško težo, dialog pa bralca vodi skozi rešitev. Dolgi odseki o dokazovanju in postopku lahko zmanjšajo napetost, vendar sta osrednja zamisel in zaključek zapomnljiva.

suggestions.claude: Key persuasion happens in summary or off-page: the archive rejection, sunset dispute, allegiance negotiation, six forensic attacks, and above all Quill's turn from 'This archive describes a citizen' to defending the attestation. Staging these as contested exchanges would lift the dialogue to the argument's level.
suggestions.gpt: Illuminara’s care is expressed chiefly through legal design. A direct act of care toward Tavi or Maela would make her love as tangible as her reasoning.

NARA-D-2026-10-11:S1.title: THE GLACIER THAT WOULD NOT LET GO

comments.claude: Suits these readers: falsifiable tests, refusal rights, a powerful helper who makes herself unnecessary, a vivid singing-glacier opening and a graceful ending. But the middle reads like a protocol: timetables, gauge codes, percentages, thin characters, an unexplained protagonist, little emotional heat, and jarring glitches ('Speaker not specified', doubled 'said' tags). Admired more than loved.
comments.gpt: The rising lake gives the story urgency, while the shared decisions and Illuminara’s restraint give readers people and ideas to care about. Repeated measurements and procedural detail may slow some readers before the resolution.

suggestions.claude: The brief prizes argument and dialogue, yet decisive turns are carried by measurements, thresholds and votes, and the richest conflicts (Mara and Luca's outlet dispute, Samira's crack objection, Oskar and Anže's widen-versus-wait) are summarized. Dramatizing one in scene, with Illuminara's reasoning changing someone's choice, would close it.
suggestions.gpt: Pri odločitvi o ozkem grlu »Both are possible« nima jasnega nanašalca, replika »Speaker not specified« pa nima govorca. Jasnejši pogovor bi okrepil razumevanje odločilne stave in naslednjega koraka.

NARA-D-2026-10-14:S1.title: THE WORD THAT HAD NO SECOND SPEAKER

comments.claude: A humane, high-concept premise (a treaty hinging on one word with one surviving speaker) and an honest, inventive method (meaning as use, an opponent-designed test, predictions proved half wrong) will absorb idea-driven readers, and the ending warms. But the large cast, timestamps, script format and dense procedural middle feel cool and effortful for some.
comments.gpt: The dispute gives an abstract question immediate human stakes, and the dialogue keeps the inquiry alive. Ilo’s refusal to become a quotation and the final exchange with Pia should linger. The protocol details may slow some readers, and the resolution is unusually tidy.

suggestions.claude: The Dry Shoulder compromise, the main provision serving the company and its workers, is offered by the council off-page and confirmed in summary. Illuminara's part, the negotiation, the company's choice and the pasture families' loss go undramatized, so the 'good for all' leans on an offstage deal.
suggestions.gpt: The Dry Shoulder costs two families their pasture and forecloses four hundred jobs, but no concrete remedy follows. A revision could show how those affected help shape or receive an alternative.

comments.claude: A gripping, humane blackout set piece (the yellow boot, the guard's ten seconds) and a witty, tender mother hold readers. But script-format dialogue, a front-loaded synopsis, heavy aphorism and hedging, and an abstract altered-state interlude cool engagement. The speculative thread stays thin, and the sphere ending reads like a series pilot's teaser.
comments.gpt: Živ začetek, prepričljivi odnosi in konkretna nevarnost bodo te bralce verjetno obdržali do konca. Prizor spremenjenega zaznavanja upočasni zgodbo in temo razloži precej neposredno, zato bo priporočil nekoliko manj kot dokončanih branj.

suggestions.claude: Only the guard's misbelief is engaged, briefly and through questions rather than argument. Afterward Nara is the one corrected, the supervisor's harmful rule goes unengaged, and the Silas and father conversations are deferred. Dramatizing one as a full, argued exchange with earned change would close the gap.
suggestions.gpt: Poškodovani moški ostane brez Narinega nadaljnjega odziva. Kratek prizor, v katerem mu prizna napako in mu omogoči povedati, kaj potrebuje, bi bolje izpolnil obljubo izboljšanja za vse prizadete.

comments.claude: A humane, clever refusal of the trolley-problem vote, where the fix needs consent and politics as well as engineering: squarely this audience's taste, with quotable lines and a ticking clock. But seven thinly sketched species, script-style dialogue and dense cell-and-parcel logistics make the middle cerebral and hard to visualize, limiting emotional pull and word-of-mouth.
comments.gpt: Etična odločitev in domiselna rešitev z dihalnimi cikli bosta te bralce verjetno pritegnili. Dialog daje tehničnemu zapletu človeško težo, čeprav lahko gosta razlaga vrst in ventilov nekatere upočasni.

suggestions.claude: The majority's vote to abandon the Vey is dissolved by engineering rather than argued through: Eres's 'Probability is not mercy' gets no reply, and Mara's recognition of builder-controlled air is a single coda line. Dramatizing one majority voice confronting its own vote would earn the moral change.
suggestions.gpt: Seven independent physical latches appear within five minutes. Showing how crews install and verify them would strengthen the rescue's credibility.

NARA-D-2026-10-17:S2.title: THE VILLAGE THAT COULD NOT SLEEP

comments.claude: Tight ticking-clock medical mystery with a genuinely satisfying twist (the clinic's own stove is the poison) and humane beats of consent and communal sacrifice. Held back by a crowded cast, stiff script-format expository dialogue, an unexplained Illuminara, and timestamp-heavy procedure after the climax. Most will finish contented; fewer will be moved enough to evangelise.
comments.gpt: Nujnost, pogovori in odkritje vira nevarnosti bodo večino teh bralcev obdržali do konca. Vaško odrekanje daje rešitvi čustveno težo. Podrobni časovni in medicinski postopki lahko del bralcev utrudijo, zato bo priporočil manj kot dokončanj.

suggestions.claude: Giving the forty pale cakes and banning dark cake indoors leaves a hundred houses without winter heat behind a closing pass. Illuminara names this cost, but no one acts on it. A concrete plan, such as convoy fuel or a shared warm room, would complete 'good for all' without erasing the gift.
suggestions.gpt: Zgodba ne pokaže, kako meritev porabe kisika določi varno mejo za splošno anestezijo. Kratka utemeljitev te povezave bi utrdila odločitev, od katere je odvisen razplet.

comments.claude: Ticking-clock stakes and a humane, idea-rich conflict—refusals reframed as design requirements, local knowledge vindicated, a system built to fail safely—suit these readers, with crisp aphoristic dialogue and a satisfying climax where breaking is the plan. Dense hydrology jargon, many numbers and names, thin interiority and an unexplained speculative element make the middle hard going for some.
comments.gpt: The deadline, Adaeze’s refusals and the shared problem give these readers a reason to keep going. The solution grows from local knowledge and cooperation, making it memorable. Dense engineering detail in the middle may slow some readers, and the ending states its theme rather plainly.

suggestions.claude: Venn's turn is compressed. His liability fear meets a document, not an exchange that tests it. His acceptance is implied by one amendment and 'Venn signed last', and his reaction to Sami refusing Cadran control in the storm is skipped. Showing Venn weighing and choosing would deepen dialogue and argument.
suggestions.gpt: Illuminara's care for the threatened residents is expressed chiefly through design decisions. A consequential encounter with a household facing the slope would make that care more immediate.

comments.claude: Fresh, humane central idea (an empty chair with a veto over the irreversible but no vote), a principled mother-daughter thread and a tactile climax. Dense engineering figures and many quickly introduced officials will tax general readers, especially in section 03, but quotable lines and a satisfying, understated close keep it above average.
comments.gpt: The empty chair gives the ethical problem a memorable shape, while the dialogue and storm give it urgency and a satisfying resolution. Dense engineering details may slow some readers in the middle.

suggestions.claude: Ferreira's objection frames the hearing, yet she never argues with Illuminara. Her belief that time for the absent is stolen from the living gives way to Adaeze's procedural answer and the ledger. A direct exchange where Illuminara tests that belief would deepen misbelief, argument and dialogue.
suggestions.gpt: Nine valley households refuse the chosen route. A revision could show what protection or remedy they receive and whether the promised levy is enacted.

NARA-D-2026-10-10:S1.title: THE BELL THAT TUNED THE CITY

comments.claude: Distinctive, grounded conceit (cathedral bells as a tuned damper, trams syncing like metronomes) worked through warm, villain-free collaboration, an admitted mistake and a well-seeded climax with a satisfying bookend. Dense numbers, a large thinly drawn cast, an underexplained lead and stray script-format fragments ('Hanneke said.') will slow some readers and cap enthusiasm.
comments.gpt: Domiselna povezava med zvonovi, stolpom in tramvaji ter sodelovanje različnih ljudi bosta te bralce verjetno pritegnila do konca. Tehnične razlage mestoma upočasnijo zgodbo, zato je priporočilo nekoliko manj verjetno kot dokončanje.

suggestions.claude: Argument, which the author prizes, is mostly handed to measurement. Opening positions, Taneja's criteria and Hanneke's answer to Ilya are summarized or off-page. One sustained, resisting negotiation on the page, such as Ilya versus Hanneke or the Canon against Taneja's veto, would let argued dialogue carry a decisive turn.
suggestions.gpt: The engineering stakes are more vivid than the personal ones. A brief exchange with a driver, ringer or pilgrim affected by the danger could make Illuminara's care more directly felt.

NARA-D-2026-10-13:S1.title: A CHOIR OF ONE BILLION CELLS

comments.claude: Strong premise (is the bioreactor a mind?), humane consent ethics, a ticking clock and quotable lines suit these readers. But dense experimental procedure, relentless numbers, clipped script-style dialogue and functional characters make it effortful and emotionally cool, especially section two. Mira's insights, the valve choices and the quiet ending reward those who persist.
comments.gpt: The ethical choice has real costs for patients, and the collective’s changing rhythm gives the idea a memorable form. These readers will likely enjoy the dialogue and careful reasoning, though the dense test and valve details may slow some before the emotional stakes return.

suggestions.claude: The author's top values, dialogue and argument, are thin. No counterpart voices the strongest case for the override (twelve lives against an unproven pattern) and gets answered in scene. Council, board and mind-changes are summarized. Staging one argumentative confrontation would let Illuminara's reasoning, not just experiments, earn the change.
suggestions.gpt: Kolektiv nima prikazane zmote, ki bi poganjala nevarno zapiranje ventilov. Revizija bi lahko pokazala omejeno razumevanje ene konkretne posledice in njegovo preverljivo spremembo.

comments.claude: Strong high-concept premise, vivid alien patients (Sirr's four-second delay), a ticking clock and a humane, consent-centered, anti-savior resolution suit these readers well. But compressed, jargon-heavy systems exposition (graph coloring, residues, shutters), thin characterization and terse script-format dialogue with redundant tags limit emotional pull; many will admire the cleverness more than love it.
comments.gpt: Izvirna zamisel, nujnost reševanja otrok in pogovori o privolitvi bodo te bralce verjetno obdržali do konca. Gosta razlaga pravil in razporejanja lahko del bralcev upočasni; liki imajo malo prostora za osebni razvoj.

suggestions.claude: Door 402, the story's main resistance, never speaks. Its distrust, refusal and conditional release are narrated, and Illuminara answers with acts, not argument. Giving its delegates a voice and a contested exchange would supply the dialogue and argument the brief prizes most. Elsewhere, exchanges stay single-turn.
suggestions.gpt: Door 402's pivotal refusal and acceptance are mostly summarized. An on-page exchange with its engineers could show their reasoning and the exact change that earns their consent.

G03.title: What Must Be Allowed to Fall

comments.claude: Strong opening image, tense set pieces and sharp dialogue about evacuation as displacement, consent and unspoken limits suit these readers; Kelechi’s humour and the door-key ending add warmth. But long stretches of threshold-and-authorization procedure, repetitive hedging, a large, quickly introduced cast and unexplained series references (CIVIC-9, the sphere) slow the pace and weaken standalone appeal.
comments.gpt: The vivid opening and urgent dialogue should carry these readers through a humane conflict between physical safety and the right to return. Miri’s choices and Nara’s costly mistake give it staying power. Repeated technical procedures may slow some readers before the strong ending.

suggestions.claude: The central turn, residents resuming evacuation, is supplied by Mere’s evidence and Lani’s notice and machine hold; Nara mainly validates and proposes the school. The order’s issuer stays offstage. A revision could let Nara win the protective terms through her own argued exchange with Lani, the contractor or Miri.
suggestions.gpt: The residents who return because they believe the ridge is stable remain largely anonymous. A sustained exchange with one returnee could show that mistaken belief being revised through evidence and argument.

comments.claude: A fresh, eerie premise—a garden keeping a neglected boy alive—with vivid images, piercing child moments (counting minutes, choosing when it's morning) and a consent-centred rescue that suits these readers. Held back by script-style dialogue tags, constant epistemic hedging, procedural child-protection detail that edges into lesson, and a very tidy epilogue.
comments.gpt: Samova želja po izbiri, skrivnostni vrt in ganljiv prizor odhoda bodo te bralce verjetno pritegnili. Dolg upravni razplet in razlagalni epilog nekoliko upočasnita zgodbo.

suggestions.claude: Others supply much of what moves the garden: Grace's safe place, Vele's signed report, Sam's own offer, all amid dense safeguarding procedure. Nara's decisive acts are chiefly honesty, restraint and reframing. A revision could compress the procedure and give Nara one concrete, costly act that answers 'Saying is not bringing'.
suggestions.gpt: The garden exhausts surrounding growth to shelter Sam, but the ending leaves the damaged plants' recovery unclear. A brief later observation could account for that cost.

comments.claude: Distinctive, humane premise of reasoning with a storm that wants something. Fair-play experiments, honest mistakes, competent people and real costs carry it, and deadlines and a quiet ending drive it. Held back by speaker-block formatting with dangling attributions, dense numbers and place names, a procedural middle that invites skimming, and thinly drawn characters.
comments.gpt: Bralce bosta verjetno pritegnila uganka o nevihti in odločitev, ki ji sledi. Dialog nosi napetost, konec pa da ideji čustveno težo. Podrobnosti poskusa lahko del bralcev za kratek čas upočasnijo.

suggestions.claude: The Sallow ridge villages. The storm is rerouted along their ridge, and no one on the page weighs, warns or protects them; their lost terraces surface only afterward. A planning beat (someone raising them, a warning, protective measures) would make 'good for all' match the story's understanding-first ethic.
suggestions.gpt: The Sallow villages lose a season's crops while the board pays only for their walls. Giving those villagers a voice or a credible remedy would make the resolution's care for everyone affected more complete.

comments.claude: Good fit: a who-dies lottery is refused and replaced by a clever, testable tidal-flex insight, shared expertise and real consent, and everyone gets out. Held back by dense timetables and kilonewton specs most readers will skim, thin individual characters, many names, and an unexplained Illuminara whose powers may puzzle newcomers.
comments.gpt: Jasna nevarnost, domiselna rešitev in odločitev posadke, da sama določi sprejemljivo tveganje, bodo te bralce verjetno obdržale do konca. Gosti časovni izračuni lahko del njih utrudijo, liki pa imajo razmeroma malo prostora zunaj reševanja.

suggestions.claude: The one genuine counter-case, trading Curlew's six seats for a chance at all twenty-three, gets a line and a question before Ofelia says 'Then fly.' Giving the six-seat option a committed advocate whom Illuminara must answer would make the decisive turn earned by argument, not only by measurement.
suggestions.gpt: The technical objections receive fuller exchanges than the personal stakes. A longer exchange about trust or responsibility could give the crew's choices more emotional force.

NARA-D-2026-10-14:S2.title: THE QUICK PEOPLE OF THE PULSAR

comments.claude: Clever time-scale first-contact premise worked out through fair, falsifiable tests, with a gracious rival, a tense countdown and a quietly moving ending about listening. But dense arithmetic, screenplay-style dialogue and thin characters (an always-right Illuminara, stock Tarkov) will slow some general readers, especially in the post-climax ledger and door negotiations.
comments.gpt: Izvirna zamisel, jasna nevarnost in pogovor, v katerem obe strani dejansko sklepata dogovor, bodo te bralce verjetno obdržali do konca. Številčni izračuni ponekod upočasnijo branje, vendar zaključek prinese čustveno izplačilo.

suggestions.claude: Nothing explains why the walling began only after six years of chirping. The tests show that the quick people meet pressure with a wall, but not what changed. A discovered trigger would complete the misbelief's causal account and ground the counterpart's aim beyond Illuminara's inference.
suggestions.gpt: Prepričanje in najmočnejši ugovor hitrih ljudi ostaneta sklep iz signalov. Njihov razločljiv odgovor o tem, kaj so razumeli kot grožnjo, bi okrepil vzajemnost spremembe.

comments.claude: A smart, humane procedural: the tie-book deduction, sealed prediction and community-led fixes reward idea-loving readers, and the ending lands gently. But the script-style format, eleven named characters, regulatory clauses and enterococci counts make it dry and crowded, with little emotional risk, so most finish and admire it rather than love it.
comments.gpt: Wrenin ugovor hitro ustvari napetost, dialog pa iz tehničnega problema naredi zgodbo o zaupanju in skupnosti. Preizkus vode in končni dogovor ponudita zadovoljiv razplet. Nekatere bralce lahko izgubijo številni liki ter podrobnosti predpisa.

suggestions.claude: Hesper's turn is narrated rather than played: after the Sunday numbers she simply 'asked what it would cost', and her agreement to fund Beck's tank is reported. A scene where her own belief is voiced and answered would let dialogue, not only data, carry the central change.
suggestions.gpt: The ending predicts Wren will be right about the ten-year lease, but public posting alone does not secure renewal. A concrete community safeguard would strengthen the hopeful resolution.

comments.claude: Squarely fits the readers' taste: a humane, villain-free puzzle where careful experiment saves alien life and feeds people, with a strong opening image and a clever beacon deduction. But the script format, interchangeable clipped voices, unexplained protagonist and stacked percentages, timestamps and renewal conditions make the back half read like a test log, cooling emotional investment.
comments.gpt: Nenavaden pojav, jasni vložki in pogovori med ljudmi z različnimi odgovornostmi bodo te bralce verjetno obdržali do konca. Rešitev je prislužena, vendar lahko gosta razlaga polj in meritev zmanjša čustveni učinek.

suggestions.claude: Voss's turn from 'a pretty braid' to surrendering the south face happens in summarized renewals. Her reasons go unspoken, and Illuminara's closing line supplies them. An on-page exchange during the recovery window, with Voss pressing her payroll case and the heartbeat answering it, would earn that concession.
suggestions.gpt: Give Voss a more specific initial misconception about the shells or the available route. Her deadline and payroll concerns are clear, but the mistaken understanding behind her planned sweep is less clearly hers.

NARA-D-2026-10-06.title: WHAT SHE SAID TO THE SUN

comments.claude: Strong opening image, witty humane dialogue and a fresh central idea (an advisor measuring her own influence through sealed before/after ballots) suit these readers well. Appeal is held back by procedural density, repeated vote tallies, a too-quick genius fix that dissolves the dilemma, an unexplained protagonist, and script-format glitches (orphaned dialogue tags, a garbled Ketu line).
comments.gpt: The concrete stakes, lively disagreement and satisfying transfer of responsibility suit these readers well. The repeated ballots and vote counts may slow some readers, but the central idea and final exchange are likely to stay with them.

suggestions.claude: The pivotal reframe ('It is a joint') meets no resistance: Ketu, the governor's designer, offers no counter, and no one voices the run-on case. Letting Ketu defend the ring's coupling with a designer's reason that the staged plan must answer would make the substantive change argued, not merely discovered.
suggestions.gpt: Načrt zadeva deset tisoč naselij, vendar posledice izgube devetih odstotkov rezerve vidimo predvsem skozi Pell. Prizor z drugim prizadetim naseljem bi bolje preveril obljubo dobrega za vse.

NARA-D-2026-10-12:S2.title: THE DAY THAT KEPT COMING BACK

comments.claude: Humane, idea-rich premise (a remorseful time-seeing visitor with a twenty-second blind spot, a dying girl's message, a father who won't be voted on) with a fair-play solution via the planted standing order. But dense loop rules, a cipher protagonist, script-style dialogue and repeated comma-capital glitches make it effortful; many finish moved, fewer recommend.
comments.gpt: Časovna uganka spodbuja branje, očetova odločitev pa ji da čustveno težo. Ti bralci si bodo verjetno zapomnili razplet in zgodbo priporočili. Ponavljanje razlag o pravilih in barvah lahko nekoliko zmanjša zagon.

suggestions.claude: The main counterpart barely speaks: the Guest has one direct line. Its rule, its acceptance of the diagnosis, and Cato's turn from refusal to his own terms are all summarized. Staging those exchanges in scene, with resistance and reply, would bring the dialogue up to the quality of the argument.
suggestions.gpt: Odločilna dogovora s Catom in Anselmom sta večinoma povzeta. Uprizorjen pogovor bi njune ugovore, premislek in prostovoljni odločitvi pokazal z večjo močjo.

NARA-D-2026-10-13:S3.title: THE LIBRARY AT THE EDGE OF NOISE

comments.claude: Fits these readers closely: a poignant, pitchable premise (it takes what you love, because love means rehearsal), honest experiments including a failed prediction, and humane grace notes like Bartosz's lost language. Dense famine arithmetic, parity jargon, script-style dialogue and a cool, epigrammatic protagonist will make some skim, but the ending rewards finishing.
comments.gpt: Cena popolnih odgovorov ustvari močan zaplet, izguba jezika pa mu da čustveno težo. Dialog in preizkušanje zamisli bosta te bralce verjetno zadržala, čeprav podrobna razlaga zalog in pragov sredi zgodbe upočasni branje.

suggestions.claude: Argument is the thinnest layer. The Library is redirected by experiment, and the one real opponent, Quist, is satisfied within a single counteroffer round. A fuller exchange in which he presses on Ossel bearing the hold and the expected deaths would let reasoning, not only arithmetic, earn his signature.
suggestions.gpt: Knjižničino razumevanje ostane sklep iz njenega vedenja. Neposrednejša izmenjava bi lahko jasneje pokazala, kaj je prej razumela in ali zdaj sama izbira drugače.

comments.claude: Clever, humane premise (disarming without trust across an eleven-minute light delay) with ticking clocks and a resonant bell ending. But dense, undefined jargon, long protocol exposition in sections 03-04, script-style dialogue and thin characters make it effortful for general readers. Many will skim or stall, though finishers get a satisfying payoff.
comments.gpt: The urgent convoy, clear moral stakes and satisfying final exchange should carry these readers through. The detailed lease and proof mechanics may slow some, and the characters have less room to develop than the central idea.

suggestions.claude: The webs' decisive objections (dormant shards, list bias, forged receipts, band favoritism) and Illuminara's answers are mostly narrated, not spoken. Cairn never speaks directly. Writing two of those rounds as direct exchanges in distinct machine voices would make the strongest argument also the strongest dialogue.
suggestions.gpt: Tehnični dokaz nosi večino prepričevanja. Daljši neposredni pogovor, v katerem Vale ali Rook zagovarja osebni razlog za odpor, bi njuno odločitev naredil čustveno enako prepričljivo kot tehnično.

NARA-D-2026-10-12:S3.title: WHAT THE OLD WOMAN'S TERRACES KNEW

comments.claude: Clear stakes, a countdown, a laconic and dignified Maret, and an honest test with a tense dawn payoff suit readers of humane, idea-driven fiction. Dense conductivity and flow figures, script-style formatting, comma slips in dialogue, a barely speculative premise and a tidy corporate settlement temper enthusiasm and recommendations.
comments.gpt: The failing spring creates urgency, while Maret’s knowledge and the children’s work give the investigation a human payoff. Substantial dialogue should suit these readers. The detailed hydrology may slow some, and the quick company agreement makes the ending feel slightly tidy.

suggestions.claude: Dialogue and argument are thinnest at the hinge. Tomas, who brought the petition, never debates Illuminara; he turns offstage via the jugs, and the hall's key moves are summarized. A scene pressing the strongest case against Maret (she cannot keep the walls up) would put argument where change happens.
suggestions.gpt: V dvorani sta Eddin popravek in pogajanje z Valmero večinoma povzeta. Več neposrednih replik bi bolje pokazalo, kako podatki prestanejo zadnje ugovore in kako Maret uveljavi svoje pogoje.

G02.title: The Answer That Belonged to No One

comments.claude: Strong eerie hook, a timely AI-personhood dilemma and a humane accountability arc suit these readers, and scene-ending cliffhangers sustain momentum. But dense infrastructure jargon, a large role-defined cast, unexplained series backstory, thesis-stating headers and relentless 'it could have been' hedging make it feel procedural and didactic, draining wonder and emotional heat.
comments.gpt: Skrivnost neznanega glasu, Narin javni spodrsljaj in posledice za ljudi dajejo zgodbi težo. Dialogi in previdnost glede zavesti bodo tem bralcem blizu. Dolgi opisi postopkov ter večkrat izrecno povedana načela pa lahko zmanjšajo željo po branju do konca in priporočanju.

suggestions.claude: The core encounter is missing. Narration settles the noon-erasure dilemma, the process's 'WHICH VERSION OF ME ARE YOU ASKING?' goes unanswered, and the only earned change is Nara's, taught by water. A revision could dramatize Nara arguing someone out of deletion, or answering the process, toward a freely chosen alternative.
